fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Robin's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
